plain: To argue against something, or to struggle hard to hold on to it

webster.text: To dispute; to strive earnestly to hold or maintain; to struggle to defend.

example.quote: Such a qualification was proposed in Convention ; but by the delegates of Massachusetts it was contested that it should not obtain.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. KING, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
